encodings.double_x: X on all 17 qubits, a per-qubit barrier run, X on all 17 again, no wait, then the measurement; ideal P1 0 on every qubit
encodings.readout: readout-0 measures all 17 qubits in |0>, readout-1 after X on all 17

preregistered.observable: per-qubit raw P(1|0) from readout-0, P(1|1) from readout-1 and P(1|XX) from double-x, each with its binomial standard error

claim.statement: P1 after X X with no wait, beside a readout-0 and readout-1 pair in one Tuna-17 batch, separates an under-rotated X from |1> misassignment on Q0 and Q6: under-rotation by the angle their zero-wait P(1|1) implies predicts 0.98 and 0.52, misassignment 0.038 and 0.013. Ramsey inverted with the matched calibration cannot separate them when X and X90 share the under-rotation, because the raw quadratures then take the readout-scale form sin^2(beta) (1 + cos phi) / 2; a fault confined to native X keeps the X90 Ramsey at the earlier scale, which Q6's raw quadrature mean (0.064 against a floor of 0.148) excludes and Q0's (0.287 against 0.175) does not.

preregistered.predictions: raw P(1|XX): Q0 0.98 and Q6 0.52 under X under-rotation by the angle the zero-wait P(1|1) implies, Q0 0.038 and Q6 0.013 (the idle floor) under |1> misassignment
preregistered.precondition: the batch's own readout pair still shows the fault (Q0 P(1|1) < 0.7, Q6 P(1|1) < 0.3); otherwise the batch reports fault-recovered and the discriminator is not read
preregistered.decision: Q0 P(1|XX) > 0.5 and Q6 P(1|XX) > 0.25 favor under-rotation; Q0 P(1|XX) < 0.1 and Q6 P(1|XX) < 0.1 favor |1> misassignment; otherwise unresolved
preregistered.t0_stop_rule: any qubit of the LCU pairs [1, 4, 10, 12, 13, 14] or of the walk set [8, 11, 13, 14] with readout-1 P1 below 0.80 or readout-0 P1 above 0.10 re-plans the layout before T0
preregistered.readmission: each of q5, q6, q7, q9 is readout-admissible when readout-0 P1 <= 0.10 and readout-1 P1 >= 0.80; a qubit also excluded by the Ramsey visibility floor stays excluded until a fresh Ramsey run clears it
preregistered.limit: the readout pair and the double X run at one calibration; leakage, whose X train plateaus instead of oscillating, needs X trains of three and more
preregistered.stop_rule: each batch: every job completed with the manifest's shots; circuit digests equal cases.json; the batch measures excluded qubits by design, so its readout limits act through the T0 stop rule and the re-admission rule
